$comment: NIZAM · vendored nizam-signalbus envelope schema | Implemented by: PFOS Contract 12 / Phase 3.1 (spec 06-two-agent-vps) | Owning requirements: R7 (envelope validation), R10 (exclusion) | Contract: 12 §4.2, §4.3. Both agents VENDOR this document; neither imports the other's code, so this file is the only thing they share about the shape of a signal. Dialect is JSON Schema 2020-12, named here in prose rather than as an absolute dialect URI because the repository is public and holds no absolute URI (steering §0b). Property names are the WIRE names of contract 12 §4.2 and architecture §1.5. The finance agent's TypeScript mirror maps them in envelopeSchema.ts, and schemaParity.test.ts fails if the two ever drift.
title: nizam-signalbus signal envelope

payload.$comment: §4.3: consent by absence. There is no field here capable of carrying a balance, a due date, an account identifier, or a narrative — not filtered, not redacted, ABSENT. additionalProperties false is what makes the other rules more than decoration (§4.3.5).

note.$comment: Directional only. An over-cap note is REJECTED, never truncated — truncation would silently ship the first 120 characters of something that was never allowed to leave (§4.3.4).

envelopeFields.$comment: The seven fields a producer submits. Held separately so the draft form and the stored form cannot disagree about them; each form closes itself with unevaluatedProperties, which is the composable spelling of additionalProperties false (§4.3.5).

ts.$comment: The producer's completion time, and the ONLY temporal field in the envelope. §4.3.2 forbids any other date or timestamp field, which is why a due date cannot be expressed.

kind.$comment: A closed set. Extending it is a schema change with its own review, not a runtime string.

tier.$comment: Two narrow tiers only. The classification whose egress set is empty in the other repository is NOT A MEMBER, so a signal claiming it fails as an unknown enum member rather than being filtered afterwards (§4.4.1, R10).

consent_scope.$comment: The bus honours it on every read, from the stored envelope (§4.5).

draftEnvelope.$comment: The WRITE form. `hash` is absent on purpose: integrity is computed by the bus over the stored envelope, so a producer cannot assert an integrity claim about its own payload (§4.2).

storedEnvelope.$comment: The READ form. Validation runs on write AND AGAIN on read (§4.2): a schema change must not silently make historical rows readable in a shape the current consent rules forbid.

hash.$comment: sha256 over ts + producer + kind + payload. Integrity, not authentication.
